items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: I won’t tell you who the actor was — this interview with a TV actor in TV Guide

ctx.x: Well we both have to look it up just to double check. But I’m pretty sure it’s not askew. But yeah, I got that from my dad and I’m happy that we had that in common. He called me once, this is shortly after I got married and he was laughing so hard he almost couldn’t talk, he said, “Lorraine I saw this anec — I won’t tell you who the actor was — this interview with a TV actor in TV Guide and he said he had taken up directing and he said, ‘One day I was sitting at my desk and I felt the desire to act literally…
I can see how that would get to your father.
